name: Founder decision: Ratify the house's language list, every surface in every listed language, the interpreter designation, and translation as paid work
markdown_description:
P17, P18, P19, and P21. The house's language list is the union of field 14 across every open seat sheet plus every language a person on the roster chose at hiring, versioned on the team home's definitions page, owned by the Operations Lead for the record, team-filled from the roster and pre-opening the seat sheets' field 14 and the founders' languages; a language never leaves the list while a person who chose it is in the house. Every house-written surface exists in every listed language under one version number before it publishes, and a page in one language when the list has two has not been published; a person's own words are never translated for the house. The brief, the slot, and the gathering run in tonight's roster's languages by the readiness block on the surface in every roster language, the room's owner speaking the languages they hold, and an interpreter designation named at the brief for a roster language the owner does not hold, on the clock, rotating under the floor, a floor act and never a customer-facing one; on a compressed window the block spoken in one language and read on the surface in the others counts as run. Translation is written by a team member who holds the language, paid on the authorship model, approved by the page's owner for meaning and a second holder for reading, under one version number; a software draft publishes only after a holder has read it and the page carries canon's disclosure line; canon's Korean terms stand untranslated in every version, held on canon's owner with `86akh7r2t`. Extends `86akhcz2y` and `86akh6755` by reference. Blocks I2, I3, rows 132 and 133. High.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
